investigation: PSI-47, DAFT / DAFT-2: a modified P-Trak condensation counter against a DustTrak photometer on cabin air and on test dust in orbit
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_daft_w0.md, section 7.1: what the counter reads, by kind of air, from the photometer reading. The indicators and dusttrak_mass_floored = max(dusttrak_mass_concentration, 1e-9 kg/m3) are derived by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: is_velcro
features.description: cabin air while Velcro is separated

features.name: is_bag
features.description: road dust in a bag (filtered air is the reference)

features.name: dusttrak_mass_floored
features.description: max(dusttrak_mass_concentration, 1e-9 kg/m3), the photometer reading floored at its resolution

targets.name: number_concentration
targets.description: what the modified P-Trak reads on the sample (lane-local)
